{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies CMakeLists.txt, cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in, and cmake/module/InstallBinaryComponent.cmake to propagate CMake install directory variables.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes binary lookup failures on distributions like Arch Linux that customize CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR. It ensures cmake install path settings are respected by the build configuration rather than relying on hardcoded directory structures."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/bitcoin.cpp, the multiprocess wrapper executable explicitly covered under the IPC area.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents the bitcoin wrapper from failing with execvp 'No such file or directory' when spawning multiprocess binaries like bitcoin-node on non-standard directory layouts."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/bitcoin.cpp and adds test/functional/tool_bitcoin.py, directly modifying and testing the bitcoin CLI wrapper tool.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.38,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a bug causing the bitcoin wrapper command to fail immediately on distributions that set CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR to 'lib'. It replaces hardcoded 'bin' and 'libexec' lookups with configured build-time paths."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
